title: run_archive_extraction docstring contradicts its only caller
detail: converters/post_processing.py documents the return value as load-bearing: Returns the extraction ROOT directory of every archive... Its ONLY caller at line 1147 does the opposite and says so: The return value is deliberately dropped. The 2026-07-29 revert (commit e7d8163, long-path and COM limits) updated the caller and the run_all_conversions note but not the callee docstring. A reader starting from the function signature is told the roots matter; they do not. Cosmetic today, but it is the kind of stale promise that invites someone to restore the reverted behaviour that was deliberately removed.
